newsitem.title: USA: WARNACO IN PACT TO EXPAND CREDIT FACILITIES.
newsitem.headline: WARNACO IN PACT TO EXPAND CREDIT FACILITIES.

text.p: Warnaco Group Inc said Tuesday it entered into a new bank agreement led by Bank of Nova Scotia and Citibank NA.

Under the terms of the new agreement, Warnaco will have available up to $900 million in a revolving credit facility and lines of credit, replacing the company's existing $750 million in current availability.
The new agreement extends through the year 2002.
In addition, the company has other existing international facilities in excess of $150 million.
The revolving credit facility can be used for general corporate purposes including acquisitions and stock repurchases, as well as for the basic support of working capital.
Warnaco makes and sells lines of women's intimate apparel.
